message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker service itself. To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine on Windows, you typically use services or Docker Desktop UI. There's also `docker-machine start` for Docker Machine. Or you can start the Docker service via `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you might need to launch Docker Desktop application.
